verdict.rationale: Datalab's own convert API and SDK list "chunks" as an output format alongside Markdown, HTML, and JSON, so pre-chunked output is a first-party capability. The evidence gives no detail on how chunks are cut, what metadata they carry, or whether they are sized for embedding. The segment endpoint only returns page ranges for logical sections, which is document splitting rather than RAG chunking, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: documentation of semantic chunk boundaries, per-chunk metadata (e.g. headings, page, bbox), embedding-ready sizing controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of chunk quality

support.subject: As an AI-native user, output comes pre-chunked for RAG — semantic boundaries, metadata, embedding-ready segments — not a wall of text

citations.quote: The SDK provides a simple interface to convert documents to Markdown, HTML, JSON, or chunks.
